title: 다섯 분의 필름
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Acoustic guitar fingerpicking in a steady eighth-note pattern. Soft, breathy male vocals with light reverb. Electric bass enters with melodic, legato lines. Minimalist percussion featuring a soft kick drum on the downbeat and subtle shaker. Key of G Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the acoustic guitar. The bass provides melodic counterpoint rather than just rhythmic support. High-frequency clarity on the vocal track emphasizes breath sounds and sibilance.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
현관 앞에 [soft kick drum enters]
창을 두드렸지
운동하는 현관에서
물을 먹고
빨래는 건조대
위에 살고 있었지
그게 일상이었어 [melodic bass enters]
어느 아침 눈을
뜨니
세상이 멈춘 것 같았어
마당 웅덩이에
